name: api-designer
description: when building a new rest api
---

<!-- Tip: Use /create-skill in chat to generate content with agent assistance -->

Limit the total number of endpoints to 5, and for each endpoint, provide the following details:

- HTTP method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE)
- Endpoint URL (e.g., /users, /products/{id})

Keep it super simple just the url, expected outcome or responses -> less is more!
